name: the built-in lock is only the rank: a re-brand and a re-binding of the same built-in are accepted
notes: The companion that keeps the lock from becoming 'built-ins are frozen'. Name, icon, workflow binding and custom fields of a built-in are an admin's to change (Plan 8 decision 7) — and re-binding is how built-ins are seeded per workspace in the first place (builtinTicketTypeDefs(defaultWorkflowId)). Same id, same rank 4, everything else different.
